certificate.pdf_facts_basis: Direct visual inspection of rendered full-page signed original, not OCR or empty pdftotext output.
certificate.phase_scope: Signed original certifies Phase1 of the PSR reference CA-PCO-002607. Scope is main datacenter shell comprising two colocation areas and administrative fit-out. It is not limited to a bare shell.
certificate.exceptions: Signed original says phase work is complete except punch-list items, deferred works and outstanding documents/drawings. It references supporting schedules and appendices A/B/C that are not supplied in this one-page public attachment. Their detailed remaining work is unknown.
certificate.html_pdf_discrepancy: Publisher HTML says Phase2 of the PSR while also saying Phase1 parenthetically. Signed PDF explicitly says Phase1 consistently; prefer the original PDF and preserve the discrepancy.
certificate.source_confidential_label: Original bears a CONFIDENTIAL label despite being publicly linked by the statutory-notice publisher. Do not redistribute the image, signatures, contact details or raw document. Only compact non-personal factual projection and citation are retained.

vaughan.review_conclusion: Do not treat this as merely a shell-only successor. The first phase had substantial completion, including some fit-out, on July15. Operator August5 still says not operational and work will continue, but exact active physical scope after substantial completion is unresolved. Root holds Vaughan pending a dated specific continuing physical-work observation or fuller phase-scope evidence. Do not infer actual operation or whole-campus completion.
